title: Что будет проверено перед выпуском
description: Что будет проверено перед выпуском: применяем правило в новых ситуациях, разбираем словарь, диалог и авторский текст без аудирования.
objectives: Отличать обещанное действие от уже выполненного
notes: Future Passive: The report will be checked. Фокус на объекте будущей проверки.
Will be checked не означает has been checked; вторая форма сообщала бы о завершении к настоящему.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.prompt: Выбери точный вариант: The final figures ___ before publication.
exercises.explanation: Будущий пассив строится will be + причастие checked.

exercises.prompt: Вставь слово из пары: inspected / inspecting.

public_payload.sentence: The equipment will be ___ next week.

exercises.editorial_answer: The equipment will be inspected next week.
exercises.explanation: Объект проверяют, поэтому inspected в пассиве.

exercises.editorial_answer: The draft will be reviewed before release.
exercises.explanation: Will be reviewed сообщает о будущей проверке, не о её завершении.

exercises.prompt: Исправь ошибку в указанной конструкции, сохраняя остальные слова и смысл.

public_payload.sentence: The results will checked by an independent reviewer.

accepted: The results will be checked by an independent reviewer.

exercises.reference_answer: The results will be checked by an independent reviewer.
exercises.incorrect_answer: The results will checked by an independent reviewer.
exercises.editorial_answer: The results will be checked by an independent reviewer.
exercises.explanation: Между will и причастием checked требуется be.

public_payload.passage: A project update said that the final figures would be checked by an independent reviewer before release. A colleague shortened this to “independently checked figures” in a presentation prepared the same day. The review had not yet happened. The project lead asked for the slide to be corrected, because a future commitment had been turned into a completed assurance. The team could describe the planned safeguard, but it needed separate evidence of completion before presenting the figures as reviewed. The release date remained conditional on that work.

options.label: It said that no reviewer had been planned.
It presented a planned review as already completed.
It accurately reported a finished independent review.

exercises.editorial_answer: It presented a planned review as already completed.
exercises.explanation: Проверка ещё не состоялась; время и статус действия были изменены.

exercises.prompt: Соедини слова с переводом в контексте урока.
exercises.editorial_answer: inspection — проверка; release — выпуск; verify — проверять; completion — завершение
exercises.explanation: В этих контекстах: inspection — проверка; release — выпуск; verify — проверять; completion — завершение.

exercises.prompt: Что нужно для заявления о проверенных данных?

public_payload.passage: A project update said that the final figures would be checked by an independent reviewer before release. A colleague shortened this to “independently checked figures” in a presentation prepared the same day. The review had not yet happened. The project lead asked for the slide to be corrected, because a future commitment had been turned into a completed assurance. The team could describe the planned safeguard, but it needed separate evidence of completion before presenting the figures as reviewed. The release date remained conditional on that work.

options.label: Evidence that the review has actually been completed.
Only the intention to arrange a review.
A shorter slide title regardless of timing.

exercises.editorial_answer: Evidence that the review has actually been completed.
exercises.explanation: Планируемая мера и доказательство её исполнения различаются.

exercises.prompt: Отдели нынешнее состояние от запланированного действия.

lines.speaker: Собеседник
lines.text: Have these documents already been reviewed?

options.label: Not yet. They will reviewed tomorrow.
Not yet. They will be reviewed tomorrow.
Yes. Will be reviewed always means completed.

exercises.editorial_answer: Not yet. They will be reviewed tomorrow.
exercises.explanation: Not yet и will be reviewed сохраняют реальную последовательность.
Completion — завершение, в отличие от предложения или оговорки.
